name: Circular Integral Convolution
definition: Generates a blurred image from a scan by integrating ray values across all angles for each point. This is equivalent to filtering the true image with a 1/r-weighted filter. It is not a full reconstruction but a pre-processing step for deconvolution.
summary: Circular Integral Convolution generates a blurred image from scan data by integrating ray values across all angles, serving as a pre-processing step for deconvolution-based reconstruction rather than a full reconstruction method.
